stress_test.design: 10 pairs per task, 5 scored >= 0.8 and 5 below; each a machine atom with its best human atom

pass1.note: blind; the question did not say to judge the shown human atom alone

pass2.note: question fixed (judge the shown pair only, containment either way, pronouns read from the response); all 30 reread; not fully blind: pass 1 disagreements were known

stress_test_set2.rater: a second rater, blind (the matcher's score and call hidden), with the pass 2 question and written instructions

matcher_note: Scores and stress-test calls from the matcher after its review (10 Oct): negation guard, -e plurals, apostrophes, 'the speaker' and lower-case name words. The pairs and the people's judgments are unchanged; only the matcher's scores were redone.
